description_en: Retrieves the quota and used quota for different refresh types
description_zh: 获取不同刷新类型的配额及配额已使用量
name: GetPurgeQuota

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2850189.html operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en:
The refresh task type. Valid values:
file (default): file refresh.
cachetag: cache tag refresh.
directory: directory refresh.
ignoreParams: parameter-stripped refresh.
hostname: hostname refresh.
purgeall: refreshes all cached content under the site
parameters.help_zh:
刷新任务类型，取值：
file（默认值）：文件刷新。
cachetag：缓存标签刷新。
directory：目录刷新。
ignoreParams：去参数刷新。
hostname：主机名刷新。
purgeall：刷新站点下所有缓存
parameters.name: type
